# Sync Socials

> Sync Socials is an AI powered social media scheduler and automation platform. Schedule once and publish everywhere: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Discord, Slack and Telegram, with X (Twitter) coming soon. AI agents can run the entire content pipeline through MCP.

Key facts:

- One dashboard for planning, scheduling and publishing to every connected platform
- Content Studio (beta) turns a website link or a short business brief into ready to post text, photo and video content built on proven viral formats
- MCP and API access lets AI agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and any MCP compatible agent) upload media, draft posts, schedule campaigns and publish
- Pricing: one Growth plan at $19.95 per month or $199.50 per year (2 months free), with a free 7 day trial and cancel anytime
- 20 accounts per platform and unlimited scheduled posts, no fees per post
- Posts publish natively through each platform's official API, so scheduled posts get the same reach and engagement as manual posts
- Accounts connect through each platform's official OAuth login; Sync Socials never sees or stores passwords
- Built and personally supported by founder Damiano Tobasco
- Partner Program pays 30% recurring commission for life plus milestone prizes up to $20,000

## Pages

- [Home](https://sync-socials.com/): features, Content Studio, integrations, MCP for agents, pricing and FAQ
- [Partner Program](https://sync-socials.com/referral.html): 30% recurring commission plus milestone prizes
- [App](https://app.sync-socials.com/): log in or start a free 7 day trial
- [Agent skill and docs](https://github.com/DamianoTobasco/sync-socials-agent): install the Sync Socials skill for MCP agents

## Install for AI agents

npx skills add DamianoTobasco/sync-socials-agent -g

Requires a Sync Socials account and an API key generated from workspace settings.
